scene: Day 98, windy grey afternoon. The narrow wet top edge of a small concrete river dam, seen from low and close. Patch (round white head, black dot eyes, orange bandage on the forehead, orange backpack, a rope tied around his waist) crouches on the edge with both mitten hands on the wet concrete, eyes huge, one sweat drop, close to the camera. On his left, a calm green lake almost up to the top; on his right, a steep drop where white foaming water roars out from under an iron gate. Far behind him on the bank, Rocio (round white head, wide-brim straw hat) holds the other end of the rope. On the far bank ahead, a few green walkers stand among low houses. Tense because one slip and he falls.

Night over a dark, abandoned city. A water-treatment plant blazes with eight huge white floodlights on tall poles, lit up like a stadium; light beams cut the darkness. In the big concrete basins below, dozens of green walkers all stare up at the lights at the same time. In the glowing glass control booth, Patch (round white head, orange bandage on the forehead, orange backpack) presses his face to the glass, eyes huge, mouth a small O; beside him Ines (yellow hooded raincoat) and Lucia (big round black-framed glasses). Tense because now the whole city can see them.
